name: Ischial Bursitis
definition: Inflammation or irritation of the ischiogluteal bursa near the ischial tuberosity, causing focal lower-buttock pain, often worsened by prolonged sitting.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound/MRI is selected for persistent or atypical cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Injection is selective after diagnosis is secure.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati/Shroni local Shotha phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation or irritation of the ischiogluteal bursa near the ischial tuberosity, causing focal lower-buttock pain, often worsened by prolonged sitting.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
